mates.responsibility: Interpret the ask, define the run boundary, and coordinate assignments across the scenario ladder.
Design simple, medium, and hard scenarios with success criteria and fallback paths.
Check approval status, scenario safety, permission needs, and stop conditions.
Execute the simple scenario and capture concise evidence.
Execute the medium scenario and capture concise evidence.
Execute the hard scenario only when boundary review allows it.
Synthesize evidence, limitations, confidence, and recommendations across all levels.
Create and verify the presentation deliverable after source conclusions are stable.
